mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates above 8.5% signal weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales (both below 480 and 390,000 respectively) indicate a broad-based weakness in consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST < 480 and RSAFS < 390000, or the interaction effect (measured by Rank IC) is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL index above 225), rising inflation erodes real corporate profits and forces central bank tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 225, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 94.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, signaling reduced corporate capacity utilization and lower future earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 94.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts below 480 thousand units reflect a weakening residential sector, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer spending and economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST is below 480.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Weak labor market conditions, indicated by total employment below 131,000 thousand persons, signal reduced household income and lower consumer demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS is below 131000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level below 13400 billion (in chained 2017 dollars) signals economic deceleration, reducing corporate profit expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 is below 13400, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
